title: Sulfur to Brimstone
description: Renames all instances of Sulfur to Brimstone.
body:
# ![Sulfur to Brimstone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/169fc26cedb3c76208b87be9c65951d99fb91469.png)
Thanks for checking out Sulfur to Brimstone! This Resource Pack <u>will change all instances of Sulfur (except for Sulfur Cube) to Brimstone.</u>

## What is Brimstone?
Brimstone is what Sulfur is called in the English Translation of the Christian Bible. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sulfur#History:~:text=English%20translations%20of%20the%20Christian%20Bible%20referred%20to%20sulfur%20as%20%22brimstone%22.)

The name comes from Old English for 'Burning Stone', with 'brim' being derived from the Proto-Germanic root 'bren', (to burn). 

## FAQ

### Why is the Sulfur Cube's name unchanged?
<u>I thought 'Brimstone Cube' sounded weird, so I didn't change it.</u>

### Did you take the idea from Mogswamp's latest YouTube Short?
<u>Yes.</u>

### Does this require any external mods?
Nope. <u>This Resource Pack does not need any external mods for it to function properly.</u>

### Can you put this pack on CurseForge?
<u>I do not plan to put this pack on CurseForge, and probably never will.</u>
